profile.summary: Walking Cinema is a San Francisco-based storytelling studio that makes audio and augmented reality (AR) walks, which are location-based stories people experience on their phones as they move through a place. It also teaches workshops and courses on location-based audio and AR storytelling to students, teachers and professionals.
